_provenance.purpose: Grounded alias table so a governance extinction pass (energy-extinction.js pattern) does not falsely retire activations. activeTriggers would be built from pulse condition-codes plus active diagnosis ids (energy-telemetry-adapter.js pattern). This table bridges condition-codes and diagnosis ids to the FREE-TEXT diagnosticTriggers carried by each _authored circuit's activation nodes.
_provenance.derivationChain: condition --(governance-pulse-engine.js classify L144-166)--> evidence family --(EVIDENCE_CONTRACTS requiredFamilies, OR-gate, L177-179)--> diagnosis id --(governance.json issues[]._authored circuit)--> circuit nodeIds --(activation.diagnosticTriggers, FREE-TEXT)--> trigger phrases. The diagnoses section is the strongest link (pure data from issues[]._authored). The condition-codes section adds the pulse-engine family hop.
_provenance.foldRule: A diagnosis is folded into a condition-code only when the condition emits an evidence family that appears in that diagnosis requiredFamilies (the actual code gate, OR-semantics). A condition that is only a diagnosis secondaryConfirmation but does not emit that diagnosis requiredFamily is NOT folded (bias against over-marking); such cases are listed under unmapped.
_provenance.discipline: No link invented. Conditions with no defensible chain are under unmapped. Trigger strings copied verbatim from governance.json; extinction matching is case-insensitive (energy-extinction.js pattern).
_provenance.heterogeneityVsFinanceAndEnergy: (1) TRIGGER SHAPE: governance activation.diagnosticTriggers are FREE-TEXT phrases (e.g. 'Executive overreach') like ENERGY, NOT diagnosis ids like Finance, so the bridge is strictly load-bearing. (2) DEAD-END CONTRACT: POLICY_FAILURE requiredFamilies [congressional_event, fiscal_event] are never emitted by the classifier, so an ENTIRE diagnosis is unreachable via condition-codes (Finance's dead-end was a single family; governance's is a whole contract). (3) MANY DEAD-END FAMILIES: policy_event, workforce_event, indicator_event, structural_event, macro_event are all emitted but required by no contract, so 14 of 24 condition tokens are ungroundable; only institutional_event and news_event bridge to any diagnosis. (4) ZERO ORPHANS: every activation carrying non-empty diagnosticTriggers appears in at least one _authored circuit (Finance had 3 orphans, Energy 1). Only SN and FG are unreachable, and both carry empty triggers, so they are extinction-exempt, not orphans.

_provenance.note: Generated deterministically from the above sources. Read-only reference data; nothing here writes governance.json or fires extinction. No governance-specific adapter/extinction module exists yet; this table follows the Energy contract so one can consume it unchanged.
